blocks.text: The complete flight control deck. Every indicator in the world. // CALIBRATE YOUR INSTRUMENTS
🧭 Trend
🏎️ Momentum
📊 Volume
🧱 Support
🧩 Patterns
🌊 Volatility
🕯️ Action
⏳ Time
Trend Lines 📏
Visual lines connecting highs or lows. They simplify chaos into a direction.

Highway Logic
Uphill road = Effort required. Trend line shows the slope of the hill.
Simple Moving Average (SMA) 〰️
The average price over X days. Smooths out daily noise to show the path.

Crowd Logic
A drunk man walks erratically (Price). His sober friend walks straight (SMA). Follow the friend.
Exponential MA (EMA) ⚡
Gives more weight to recent prices. Reacts faster than SMA.

News Logic
Today's newspaper is more important than last month's. EMA cares about Today.
ADX 💪
Average Directional Index. Measures the STRENGTH of a trend, not direction.

Speedometer
It shows 100kmph. It doesn't care if you are going North or South, just that you are Fast.
Ichimoku Cloud ☁️
Japanese "One Glance" chart. Shows support, resistance, and trend all at once.

Weather Forecast
If Price is above the Cloud, it is a Sunny Day (Buy). Below Cloud = Rainy Day (Sell).
Parabolic SAR ✨
Stop and Reverse. Dots below candle = Bullish. Dots above = Bearish.

Chasing Dog
The dots chase the price. If price stops or turns, the dots catch up and flip signal.
RSI ⚡
Relative Strength Index. Speed of price change. Overbought (>70) vs Oversold (<30).
Simulation: The Biryani Limit
Status: BALANCED (Eat More)
MACD 🏎️
Moving Average Convergence Divergence. Detects trend reversals early.

Gear Shift
You feel the engine rev (MACD) before the car actually speeds up.
Stochastic Oscillator 🎢
Compares closing price to price range. Very sensitive.

Rocket Fuel
A rocket slows down at the top before falling. Stochastic spots that slowdown.
CCI 🌡️
Commodity Channel Index. Measures deviation from statistical average.

Fever Check
Normal body temp is 37°C. If CCI hits +100, the market has a fever (Overheated).
Volume Bars 📶
Shows participation. Price moving without volume is a trap.
"Clapping in a stadium. The sound is REAL. The move is trusted."
VWAP ⚖️
Volume Weighted Average Price. Used by Institutions. The "Fair Price" of the day.

Wholesale Rate
Big dealers (FIIs) only buy near VWAP. They don't pay Retail MRP.
On-Balance Volume (OBV) 💧
Cumulative volume flow. Helps spot smart money accumulation.

Water Tank
If water (volume) keeps filling the tank, pressure (price) will eventually burst up.
Money Flow Index (MFI) 💸
Like RSI, but includes Volume. Known as Volume-weighted RSI.

Cash Count
Are people putting money IN or taking money OUT? MFI tracks the cash.
Support & Resistance 🪜
Price floors (Support) and ceilings (Resistance) based on history.

Psychology
Support = "Cheap, Buy Now". Resistance = "Expensive, Sell Now".
Fibonacci Retracement 🌀
Mathematical ratios (38%, 50%, 61%) where price naturally pulls back.

Rubber Band
Stretch a rubber band and let go slightly. It snaps back to a natural point (50%).
Pivot Points 📍
Calculated levels based on yesterday's High, Low, and Close.

Building Floors
Price moves from Floor 1 (R1) to Floor 2 (R2). Pivots are the concrete slabs.
Reversal Patterns ↩️
Head & Shoulders, Double Top. Signals a U-Turn in trend.

U-Turn
Like a car slowing down, turning wheels, and reversing.
Continuation Patterns ⏯️
Flags, Pennants. Signals a pause before continuing same direction.

Chai Break
Workers stop for 10 mins (Flag), then resume working (Trend continues).
Bollinger Bands 🌊
Bands expand when wild, contract when quiet. Price stays inside 95% of time.

River Width
Narrow river = Calm. Wide river = Flood. Don't swim during a flood.
ATR 📏
Average True Range. Measures the average daily move size.

Road Conditions
Highway (High ATR) vs Gully (Low ATR). Determines your Stop Loss size.
Donchian Channels 🛣️
Plots the Highest High and Lowest Low over X days. Breakout indicator.

The Box
Price is trapped in a box. When it breaks the lid (Upper Channel), it flies.
Candlesticks 🕯️
Doji, Hammer, Engulfing. Visual representation of buyer/seller war.

Boxing Match
Big Green Candle = Knockout punch by Buyer. Small Candle = Just a jab.
Market Structure 📈
Higher Highs (Uptrend) vs Lower Lows (Downtrend).

Staircase
As long as you are stepping UP, you are going to the roof.
Context Zoom 🔍
Monthly (Trend) > Daily (Setup) > 15-min (Entry).

Google Maps
Zoom Out = City View (Direction). Zoom In = Street View (Potholes). You need both.
